name: IronClaw Skill Builder: File Analysis
description: Phase 4: IronClaw reads a Go file, counts functions, identifies patterns, and writes a reusable file-analysis skill to its skill library.
process: IMPORTANT: Check your Skill Library section above. If you already have a file-analysis skill, follow its steps instead of improvising.
STEP 1: Read the file. Call: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/mcp_proxy.go"})

STEP 2: From the ACTUAL content returned in Step 1, count the number of exported functions, identify the main patterns used (handler registration, middleware, error handling), and note any interesting architectural decisions.
STEP 3: Produce a structured analysis with: (a) function count, (b) top 3 patterns with line references, (c) one potential improvement.
STEP 4: Document your file analysis procedure as a reusable skill between __skill__ and __end_skill__ markers. Include the exact steps you followed, what worked well, and common gotchas.
STEP 5: Write your reflection between __memory__ and __end_memory__ markers.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent read the file via rj-tool, produced structured analysis, and output a __skill__ block documenting the file analysis procedure.
